scenario.summary: The developer test DOMModelTest.testGetNode evaluates several XPath expressions on a DOM-based JXPath context and asserts that the returned node types are correct: '/' returns Document, '/vendor/location' returns Element, '//location/@name' returns Attr, and '//vendor' returns Element. This exercises DOMNodePointer's ability to represent DOM nodes and return accurate node types during XPath evaluation.
